title: phlegmariurus picardae
intro: Phlegmariurus picardae, commonly known as Picard's climbing fern, is a species of plant in the lycopodiaceous family. It is a type of epiphytic or terrestrial fern that grows in tropical and subtropical regions. The health benefits of Phlegmariurus picardae include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-cancer properties.
